parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The data source of the exception. Set the value to sas.

parameters.name: LevelsOn
parameters.description:
The severities of alert notifications. Valid values:

*   **remind**
*   **suspicious**
*   **serious**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas save-susp-event-user-setting --from sas --levels-on suspicious,serious,remind --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
